name: Anthropic
description: AI safety company developing Claude, a large language model assistant.
longDescription: Anthropic is an AI safety company focused on developing reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. They created Claude, a powerful large language model designed with constitutional AI methods to be helpful, harmless, and honest.

name: OpenAI
description: Creator of GPT-4, ChatGPT, and DALL-E large language and vision models.
longDescription: OpenAI is a leading AI research company that developed GPT-4, one of the most advanced large language models available. Their products include ChatGPT, DALL-E, and Whisper, serving millions of users worldwide.

name: Meta AI (Llama)
description: Open-source large language models from Meta including Llama 2 and Llama 3.
longDescription: Meta AI develops and releases open-source large language models, with their Llama series becoming some of the most widely-adopted open-source models in the industry. Llama models power many enterprise and research applications.

name: Mistral AI
description: European AI company developing efficient open-source language models.
longDescription: Mistral AI is a French AI company focused on developing efficient, high-performance open-source language models. Their Mistral 7B and larger models are known for excellent performance-to-size ratios and ease of deployment.

name: Google DeepMind
description: Advanced AI research division focused on general AI capabilities and applications.
longDescription: Google DeepMind is a combined AI research organization developing frontier AI systems including Gemini, AlphaFold, and AlphaGo. They conduct cutting-edge research in machine learning, reinforcement learning, and multimodal models.

name: Cohere
description: Enterprise AI platform providing large language models and embedding models.
longDescription: Cohere provides enterprise-grade language AI for custom business applications. Their platform includes foundational language models, fine-tuning capabilities, and embeddings for semantic search and classification tasks.

name: Cursor
description: AI-powered code editor built on VS Code for faster software development.
longDescription: Cursor is a modern code editor powered by AI that helps developers write code faster with intelligent autocomplete, code generation, and context-aware assistance. It's built on VS Code foundations with AI at its core.

name: Replit
description: Cloud-based IDE with AI coding assistance for learning and prototyping.
longDescription: Replit is a cloud-based development environment with built-in AI coding assistance, collaboration features, and deployment capabilities. It enables developers to code, build, and ship projects directly from the browser.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI pair programmer providing code suggestions and completions in your editor.
longDescription: GitHub Copilot is an AI-powered code completion tool that provides context-aware code suggestions directly in your IDE. Built on large language models, it helps developers write code faster and explore new APIs.

name: Weights & Biases
description: ML experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and model management platform.
longDescription: Weights & Biases (W&B) provides an experiment tracking and model management platform for machine learning teams. It enables tracking of hyperparameters, metrics, and model artifacts across the ML development lifecycle.

name: LangSmith
description: Platform for building, testing, and monitoring LLM-powered applications.
longDescription: LangSmith is a comprehensive platform from LangChain for developing and deploying LLM applications. It provides tools for tracing, testing, debugging, and monitoring production language model systems.

name: Hugging Face
description: Open-source platform hosting models, datasets, and tools for ML community.
longDescription: Hugging Face is the leading open-source platform for machine learning with a vast hub of pre-trained models, datasets, and transformers. It serves millions of developers and researchers globally.

name: vLLM
description: High-throughput and memory-efficient LLM serving engine.
longDescription: vLLM is an open-source library for efficient LLM inference and serving. It introduces optimized algorithms like paged attention to dramatically improve throughput and reduce memory usage in production deployments.

name: Pinecone
description: Fully managed vector database for semantic search and similarity applications.
longDescription: Pinecone is a managed vector database service that makes it simple to build high-performance semantic search and RAG applications. It provides instant retrieval of embeddings at massive scale with minimal latency.

name: Weaviate
description: Open-source vector database with built-in generative AI capabilities.
longDescription: Weaviate is an open-source vector database designed for AI-first applications. It combines vector search with generative AI models to enable semantic search, recommendation systems, and knowledge graph applications.

name: MLflow
description: Open-source platform for managing ML lifecycle from training to production.
longDescription: MLflow is an open-source platform for managing the machine learning lifecycle. It provides tools for tracking experiments, packaging models, and deploying ML applications across different environments.

name: Zapier AI
description: Automation platform integrating AI to connect apps and streamline workflows.
longDescription: Zapier is a leading automation platform that connects thousands of applications. Their AI-powered features enable businesses to automate complex workflows across their entire tech stack without coding.

name: Make.com
description: Visual workflow automation platform with AI integration capabilities.
longDescription: Make (formerly Integromat) is a powerful automation platform enabling users to create complex workflows visually. It integrates AI capabilities for intelligent data processing and decision-making in automated workflows.

name: CrewAI
description: Framework for building multi-agent AI systems and autonomous workflows.
longDescription: CrewAI is a framework designed to orchestrate autonomous AI agents to work together on complex tasks. It enables developers to create AI teams that can collaborate, communicate, and solve problems autonomously.

name: AutoGen
description: Framework for building multi-agent conversation systems with large language models.
longDescription: AutoGen is an open-source framework from Microsoft for building applications with multiple AI agents that can converse and collaborate. It simplifies the development of complex multi-agent AI systems.

name: Schneider Electric
description: Global leader in energy management and containment solutions for data centers.
longDescription: Schneider Electric provides comprehensive solutions for data center power, cooling, and containment. They offer products and services for efficient heat dissipation, power distribution, and infrastructure management.

name: Subzero Engineering
description: Liquid cooling containment systems for high-density AI data centers.
longDescription: Subzero Engineering specializes in advanced liquid cooling containment systems designed for high-density computing environments. Their solutions are engineered for AI infrastructure requiring extreme cooling efficiency.

name: Upsite Technologies
description: Hot aisle and cold aisle containment solutions for data center optimization.
longDescription: Upsite Technologies provides containment solutions including hot aisle enclosures and hot aisle doors. Their products optimize airflow and reduce cooling costs in data center environments.

name: Polargy
description: Immersion cooling systems for high-performance computing and AI infrastructure.
longDescription: Polargy develops immersion cooling technology where components are submerged in non-conductive cooling fluid. This approach dramatically increases cooling efficiency for AI and GPU-intensive applications.

name: Vertiv
description: Critical infrastructure solutions including cooling systems for data centers.
longDescription: Vertiv is a global leader in data center infrastructure providing cooling, power, and monitoring solutions. They serve enterprises and colocation providers with reliable thermal management systems.

name: CoolIT Systems
description: Direct liquid cooling solutions for GPUs and high-performance computing.
longDescription: CoolIT Systems specializes in direct liquid cooling technology for GPUs and processors. Their solutions enable extreme performance computing by providing superior thermal management compared to air cooling.

name: Green Revolution Cooling
description: Immersion cooling and data center thermal management systems.
longDescription: Green Revolution Cooling (GRC) develops immersion cooling technology that reduces energy consumption in data centers. Their systems are designed for high-density computing and GPU clusters.

name: Iceotope
description: Sealed liquid cooling systems for modular, efficient AI infrastructure.
longDescription: Iceotope provides sealed liquid cooling systems in modular designs for AI and HPC applications. Their technology enables higher density computing while reducing power consumption and operational costs.

name: Eaton
description: Electrical power management solutions for data centers and enterprises.
longDescription: Eaton is a global manufacturer of power distribution, backup power, and management solutions. They provide UPS systems, PDUs, and electrical infrastructure for mission-critical data center applications.

name: ABB
description: Industrial electrification and power solutions for data center infrastructure.
longDescription: ABB is a leading global technology company providing power and automation solutions. They supply high-voltage equipment, power conversion systems, and energy management solutions for data centers.

name: Generac
description: Backup power generation systems and power management solutions.
longDescription: Generac is a leading manufacturer of backup power generation and energy management systems. Their products provide reliable power backup for data centers and critical infrastructure.

name: Cummins
description: Power generation and backup systems for data centers and industrial use.
longDescription: Cummins is a global power leader providing engines and power generation systems. They serve data center operators with reliable backup power and genset solutions.

name: Panduit
description: Network cabling, connectivity, and infrastructure solutions for data centers.
longDescription: Panduit is a leading manufacturer of physical infrastructure solutions including cabling, connectivity, and cable management systems for data centers and enterprise networks.

name: Leviton
description: Network cabling, structured cabling systems, and connectivity products.
longDescription: Leviton manufactures network cabling, structured cabling systems, and connectivity solutions for data centers. Their products support high-speed data transmission and infrastructure requirements.

name: CommScope
description: Comprehensive networking and cabling infrastructure solutions.
longDescription: CommScope is a global infrastructure solutions company providing cabling, connectivity, and network solutions for data centers and enterprises at scale.

name: Corning
description: Fiber optic and advanced glass-based cabling solutions for networks.
longDescription: Corning manufactures optical fiber, glass components, and connectivity solutions. Their fiber optic cabling products support high-speed, long-distance data transmission in data center networks.

name: DPR Construction
description: Data center construction and infrastructure development services.
longDescription: DPR Construction is a leading construction company specializing in data center projects. They provide design-build services for new data center facilities and major infrastructure expansions.

name: Holder Construction
description: Construction services for data center development and facility expansion.
longDescription: Holder Construction provides construction and project management services for data center and critical infrastructure facilities. They specialize in large-scale, complex infrastructure projects.

name: Turner Construction
description: Major construction company with data center and infrastructure expertise.
longDescription: Turner Construction is one of the largest construction companies globally, providing services for data center development, major infrastructure projects, and facility modernization.

name: Nlyte Software
description: Data center infrastructure management (DCIM) software platform.
longDescription: Nlyte Software provides comprehensive data center infrastructure management (DCIM) solutions. Their platform enables operators to manage physical assets, power, cooling, and capacity across data centers.

name: Sunbird DCIM
description: Cloud-based DCIM platform for data center operations and optimization.
longDescription: Sunbird provides a cloud-based DCIM platform that helps data center operators manage infrastructure, track assets, optimize power consumption, and improve operational efficiency.

name: Device42
description: Infrastructure management software for IT assets and data centers.
longDescription: Device42 provides comprehensive infrastructure management and IT asset discovery software. It helps organizations track devices, applications, licenses, and dependencies across complex IT environments.

name: CoreWeave
description: GPU cloud platform optimized for AI and machine learning workloads.
longDescription: CoreWeave is a specialized GPU cloud provider offering high-performance computing infrastructure optimized for AI, machine learning, and graphics-intensive applications at scale.

name: Lambda
description: Cloud GPU instances and on-demand computing for AI and deep learning.
longDescription: Lambda provides cloud GPU instances and on-demand computing resources optimized for AI, machine learning, and scientific computing. Their platform focuses on ease-of-use and competitive pricing.

name: RunPod
description: Serverless GPU computing platform for AI inference and training.
longDescription: RunPod is a serverless GPU computing platform enabling developers to run AI models, train models, and perform GPU-intensive tasks without managing infrastructure.

name: Together AI
description: Open-source model hosting and inference platform with GPU cloud.
longDescription: Together AI provides a platform for hosting and running open-source language models at scale. They offer serverless inference, fine-tuning, and distributed training capabilities.

name: Equinix
description: Global leader in data center colocation and interconnection services.
longDescription: Equinix operates a globally distributed platform of data centers providing colocation, interconnection, and managed services. They are the largest colocation provider worldwide.

name: Digital Realty
description: Major data center colocation and managed services provider worldwide.
longDescription: Digital Realty is a leading global provider of data center colocation, interconnection, and managed services. They serve enterprises, cloud providers, and network operators.

name: QTS (Qualitytech)
description: Data center colocation with focus on enterprise and government customers.
longDescription: QTS provides premium data center colocation services to enterprises and government agencies. Their facilities offer high-density power, advanced cooling, and security features.

name: Switch
description: Hyperscale data center colocation specializing in carrier-neutral facilities.
longDescription: Switch operates carrier-neutral data centers designed for hyperscale computing. They provide premium colocation services with focus on power density and redundancy.

name: NIST AI
description: U.S. government standards and guidance for AI risk management.
longDescription: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology) develops AI risk management frameworks and standards. Their AI RMF provides guidance for responsible AI development and deployment.

name: Partnership on AI
description: Multi-stakeholder organization addressing AI governance and ethics.
longDescription: Partnership on AI brings together organizations from industry, civil society, and academia to ensure AI systems are trustworthy, safe, and beneficial for society.

name: Center for AI Safety
description: Research organization focused on making AI systems safer and more reliable.
longDescription: The Center for AI Safety (CAIS) conducts research on AI safety, interpretability, and governance. They work on technical and policy solutions to ensure advanced AI systems are safe.

name: Bloom Energy
description: Solid oxide fuel cell technology for distributed energy generation.
longDescription: Bloom Energy develops fuel cell technology for on-site power generation. Their systems provide clean, reliable power for data centers and enterprises seeking energy independence.

name: Enchanted Rock
description: Distributed power generation using natural gas to reduce grid impact.
longDescription: Enchanted Rock provides on-site power generation technology for data centers and industrial facilities. Their systems reduce reliance on grid power and provide operational flexibility.

name: Schneider Electric Sustainability
description: Energy management and sustainability solutions for data center operations.
longDescription: Schneider Electric's sustainability initiatives include energy management systems and efficiency solutions for data centers. They help operators reduce energy consumption and carbon footprint.
